heading.title: Duties of Appropriate Government, Local Authority and Parents

article.title: Duty of parents and guardian.
article.content: It shall be the duty of every parent or guardian to admit or cause to be admitted his or her child or ward, as the case may be, to an elementary education in the neighbourhood school.
article.html:
10Duty of parents and guardian.

Section 10 · Chapter III · page 7 of the Act

It shall be the duty of every parent or guardian to admit or cause to be admitted his or her child or ward, as the case may be, to an elementary education in the neighbourhood school.
